name: netblueprint-forge
description: NetBlueprint Forge: interview-driven threat modelling that produces a validated context model, a self-contained interactive diagram and clause-level framework coverage. This file only names the checks and build steps; the scripts have no dependencies.
author: DigitalPrez, LLC
